maddeler.e:
نتعادل (form VI)
# نَتَعَادَلُ (nataʕādalu) /na.ta.ʕaː.da.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَعَادَلَ (taʕādala)
# نَتَعَادَلَ (nataʕādala) /na.ta.ʕaː.da.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَعَادَلَ (taʕādala)
# نَتَعَادَلْ (nataʕādal) /na.ta.ʕaː.dal/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَعَادَلَ (taʕādala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
